event.first_work.desc: The last line on the duty roster. Wrap up today's chores — then wait for whoever knocks.
event.carmen_lecture_1.desc: Carmen's voice fills the hall. After this lecture you'll find a few more reasons to carry on.
event.exercise.desc: A few laps down the corridor. Sweat is sometimes more reliable than thought.
event.exercise_2.desc: Blood surging. The body is adapting — the ache is normal.
event.exercise_3.desc: Another set. Limits exist to be moved.
event.health_learning.desc: Digest the vitality earned from training into real growth.
event.find_Person.desc: Post a notice, interview a few strangers. The money is spent; whether the right ones come is luck.
event.find_Person_II.desc: Hands are not enough. This time you need fixers who know their trade.
event.find_Person_III.desc: Expand the roster further. Signing bonuses cost more than wages, but nobody haggles.
event.fixerWork.desc: Send the fixers out. They carry the risk; you pay the bill.
event.enhancement.desc: Drugs, equipment, and a dash of courage. After getting stronger, don't look back at the price.
event.askformoney.desc: Ask the fine ladies and gentlemen of the city. Whether they pay depends on how well you tell the story.
event.time_pass_institute.desc: The pendulum never stops. Time takes some things, and brings others.
event.illness.desc: Coughing spreads along the corridors. Leave it alone, and things will get worse.
event.illness_2.desc: The illness worsens. Medicine, rest, or something worse.
event.health_learnt_1.desc: Lessons bear fruit. Twist vitality and skill into one thread and make something real.
event.health_learnt_2.desc: A level deeper. The craft in your hands starts to catch up with the blueprint in your mind.
event.health_learnt_3.desc: Mastery. You could teach others now — if only there were anyone to teach.
event.work_basic.desc: Hauling, assembly, sweeping. Trade sweat for funds, and for a sturdier body.
event.work_basic_2.desc: You've gotten good at this. The same work, done faster and steadier.
event.work_basic_3.desc: A veteran now. Your coworkers all want you on their shift.
event.hereisauthor.desc: Someone claiming to be 'the author' is peeking through the door. Let him in; he might leave something behind.
event.study_basic.desc: Put your thoughts in order. What is understood can be done.
event.prepare_defense.desc: Spend money to reinforce the gates and stock the gear. May it never be needed.
event.time_A.desc: Michelle stares out the window. Today's despair needs an outlet.
event.time_B.desc: The clouds haven't lifted. Michelle has started losing sleep.
event.time_C.desc: The despair spreads. Even the corridor lamps seem dimmer.
event.time_D.desc: Michelle has stopped asking questions. That is more unsettling than tears.
event.time_E.desc: The final window. Either hold her back, or watch her sink.
event.time_F.desc: Someone filed a report upstairs. Eighteen names will decide the fate of the institute.
event.strongRecover.desc: With expensive medicine and a dearer resolve, bargain with old age itself.
event.findMusic.desc: Dig through the storage room for old records. Whatever you find depends on your fingers' mood.
event.music_origin.desc: A melody rises from deep in memory — the place where it all began.
event.music_saikai.desc: Reunion. Some meetings happen only in song.
event.music_childrenofcity.desc: The children of this city have songs of their own.
event.music_araya.desc: Echoes of the empty house, turning in your ears.
event.music_betweentwoworld_1.desc: There is a seam between two worlds, and the wind blows through it.
event.music_betweentwoworld_2.desc: The seam has widened. Perhaps you could cross.
event.music_rendezvous.desc: The promised hour. The music keeps the appointment for you.
